userStories.title: Parse and send the profile and app flags in agro node create
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `agro node create` to accept `--profile agro|sandbox`, `--docker`, `--t3`, and `--code-server` so that I can create an agro-profile node from the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: Before the change, a new test in `.agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` for `create --profile agro` fails (red).
`create --spec n4 --ssh-key key-1` with no new flag posts the body `{ profile: "sandbox", spec: "n4", sshKeyIds: ["key-1"] }`, with no `docker`, `t3`, or `runtimeSettings` key.
`create --profile agro --spec n4 --ssh-key key-1` posts `profile: "agro"` with no `docker`, `t3`, or `runtimeSettings` key.
`create --profile=agro` (inline form) posts `profile: "agro"`.
`create --profile agro --docker --t3 --code-server` posts `docker: true`, `t3: true`, and `runtimeSettings: { codeServerEnabled: true }`.
Each of `--docker`, `--t3`, and `--code-server` alone with `--profile agro` posts only its own field.
`create --profile desktop` exits 1, prints `--profile must be agro or sandbox` to stderr, and makes no API call.
`create --profile` with no value exits 1, prints `--profile requires a value`, and makes no API call.
With the profile `sandbox`, explicit or default, each of `--docker`, `--t3`, and `--code-server` exits 1, prints `<flag> requires --profile agro`, and makes no API call.
When the console returns HTTP 422 with the code `RUNTIME_SETTINGS_DISABLED`, the command exits 1 and prints `HTTP 422 RUNTIME_SETTINGS_DISABLED: Runtime settings are disabled`.

`nodeHelp` shows the usage line `node create --spec <spec> [--profile agro|sandbox] [--docker] [--t3] [--code-server] [--ssh-key <uuid>]... [--name <name>] [--free-tier] [--json]` and one sentence for each new flag.
`npx vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts` exits 0.
`npm --prefix .agro/cli run typecheck` exits 0.
userStories.notes: AC1 executed: new tests against cad345b2 node.ts fail (x posts the agro profile with --profile agro and no app field). AC2-AC11 executed: npx vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts exit 0, 61 passed; each AC has a named test (exact bodies, no-call checks, 422 RUNTIME_SETTINGS_DISABLED, help usage line). AC12 executed: same command exit 0. AC13 executed: npm --prefix .agro/cli run typecheck exit 0.

userStories.title: Document the new create flags
userStories.description: As an operator, I want `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` to describe the new flags so that the documentation matches the CLI.
acceptanceCriteria: The verb table row for `agro node create` in `docs/lifecycle-commands.md` shows the same usage line as `nodeHelp`.
The `## Remote console nodes: agro node` section states that the profile is `sandbox` by default and that `--profile agro` creates an agro-profile node.
The section states that `--docker`, `--t3`, and `--code-server` require `--profile agro`, and that an omitted flag lets the console default apply: Docker on, T3 off, code-server off.
`bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh docs/lifecycle-commands.md` reports no finding on a changed line.
userStories.notes: Round 1 repair aa9d910a. AC1 executed: usage line grep in docs equals nodeHelp. AC2 reasoned: section states default sandbox and --profile agro. AC3 reasoned: app-flag bullet states the requirement and the console defaults. AC4 executed: bash .agro/skills/ste/scripts/ste-check.sh docs/lifecycle-commands.md exit 0. Extra executed: npx vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/docs-reference.test.ts exit 0 (4 passed); pnpm test exit 0 (110 files, 2759 passed).

userStories.title: Record the manual review transcript
userStories.description: As the advisor, I want a command transcript of the new behavior so that the PR `## Manual review` section has evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: `.agro/tasks/node-create-profile-flags/evidence/manual-review.md` holds the output of `node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js node --help` after `npm --prefix .agro/cli run build`, with the new usage line.

The transcript holds the stderr and exit code of `create --profile desktop` and of `create --t3` with the default profile. Each command runs with `AGRO_CONSOLE_TOKEN=dummy AGRO_CONSOLE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9`. Each command exits 1 with the flag error and makes no API call.
The transcript holds the posted request bodies from the stubbed test run for `--profile agro --docker --t3 --code-server` and for the default profile.
The story creates no live console node. The story calls no live console API.
userStories.notes: AC1 executed: npm --prefix .agro/cli run build exit 0; node .agro/cli/dist/agro.js node --help exit 0, shows the new usage line. AC2 executed: create --profile desktop and create --t3 with dummy token and http://127.0.0.1:9 each exit 1 with the flag error and no request failed line. AC3 executed: npx vitest run .agro/cli/src/__tests__/node.test.ts exit 0, 61 passed; evidence quotes the asserted bodies with file:line. AC4 reasoned: only the unreachable local URL and the stubbed fetch were used; no server, no console node.
